title: § 28-315.7.1 Security grilles on buildings in occupancy groups B or M.

blocks.html:
Security grilles abutting sidewalks on buildings in occupancy groups B or M shall comply with the retroactive requirements of item 4 of section 1010.1.4.4 of the New York city building code. On and after July 1, 2026, such grilles when closed shall permit visibility from the sidewalk of at least 70 percent of the area covered by such grille.
(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
